content.text: Properties > Madison > High Point Plaza High Point Plaza The building is strategically located on Mineral Point Road, just three blocks west of West Towne Mall. Situated on a four-lane boulevard, High Point Plaza offers its tenants excellent transportation linkages, as well as an escape from the monotony and traffic hassles of office park existence. The location is dynamic, and less than 15 minutes away from most of Madison, Verona, Middleton, Cross Plains, and Mount Horeb. For property leasing info click here 7617 Mineral Point Road, Madison, WI 53717 Features Monument and building signage available Well-lit, attractive parking lot Atrium spanning all three floors with skylight Amenities Easy access to 12/18 Beltline Highway Minutes from the super-regional West Towne Mall Many casual and fine dining restaurants nearby – – “The management is very responsive to any concerns I have and the maintenance staff is professional and prompt.
